metadata.title: iOS Shortcut — Remove Gemini Watermark in One Tap
metadata.description: Download the iOS shortcut to instantly remove Gemini AI watermarks from images via the share menu in Photos, X, and other apps.

title: iOS Shortcut
description: Install this shortcut to remove Gemini watermarks directly from the share menu in Photos, X, or any app. No browser needed — process images anytime, anywhere.
install_description: Tap the button below to install directly on your iPhone, or download the file and import it manually.

step1.title: Share an Image
step1.description: In Photos, X (Twitter), or any app that supports sharing, select an image and tap the Share button.
step1.details: Choose this shortcut from the share menu. The image is automatically passed to the next step.

step2.title: Automatic Processing
step2.description: The shortcut uploads the image to our server, removes the Gemini watermark, and returns the clean result.
step2.details: The entire process is fully automatic and typically completes in 2-3 seconds. Supports PNG, JPEG, and WebP.

step3.description: The shortcut communicates with our server using these settings:

step4.title: Save to Photos
step4.description: The processed image is automatically saved to your iPhone's photo library.
step4.details: Images are saved as PNG for best quality. The original image is never modified.

notes.note1: Authentication is required. Go to Settings > API Keys on our website to generate an API Key, then add it in the shortcut configuration.
notes.note2: Only supports original Gemini-generated images. Non-Gemini images will not have watermarks detected.
notes.note3: Each image processing consumes 1 credit. Insufficient credits will result in a failed request.

tips.tip1: Generate your API Key from Settings > API Keys on our website and paste it into the shortcut's Authorization field.
tips.tip2: Batch processing is supported: select multiple images in Photos and share them all at once.
